additional_info.subject: Notes for L2
additional_info.body:
Site intervention carried out on 28/08/2024:
At first, the RC replaced the Ecog. After replacing, charger was rebooted and checked. The same error Fec_Current_Flow_In_Cablecheck occurred.
Hence, after that checked the converters and found to be in good condition. Still the error was present.
Then RC replaced the cable itself and rebooted the charger. The error disappeared.
But the error of Outlet1-OOO present.
Checked the LEM address in configuration, address field was blank. Hence, updated the LEM address. Rebooted charger.
Now the Outlet1-OOO error was toggling. So checked for the loose connections and Ethernet cable, all connections were good.
Ethernet cable was replaced with the spare one, still the same error. Swapped the port on Ethernet switch (P3 to P4, P4 to P3) but still the same error.
After this, we tried pinging the LEM meter on Outlet 1 but was not able to ping. Just to confirm, we ping the LEM meter on outlet 2 as well, which pinged successfully. Hence we suspect that, LEM meter on Outlet1 is faulty.
Therefore, just to confirm we asked him to replace the LEM meter with the spare one. But spare was not available and also RC had to leave the site due to time limit. The LEM meter check will be carried out in next intervention, which maybe carried out tomorrow or RC will inform us the date.
We have asked RC to carry the spare LEM meter in next site intervention.

**UPDATE**
Pls check with RC when next site intervention be planned
